about: Uniform tests of big-city permit search portals for the 'Permit search done right' recognition (owner: 'do 1 and 3', 2026-11-23). Cities = the 15 most populous US cities, Census Vintage 2025 (Table 5, release of 2026-05-14). All tests run anonymously (no account, no agreement accepted) from the in-app browser.

tests.noAccount: The address search works without logging in, registering or accepting a click-through agreement.
tests.addressSearch: You can search by street address.
tests.publicAddressReturnsRecords: A search for a public building's address (city hall or similar) returns that building's permits.
tests.inspectionResultsVisible: Extra, not required to pass: a permit's completed inspections show their result (pass/fail/approved) to an anonymous visitor.
tests.oldestRecordAtTestAddress: Extra, not required: the oldest record date the search returned at the test address. This is NOT the start of the city's online records.

rule: A city that passes the three core tests is listed. A city that also shows inspection results anonymously is named a 'Permit search done right' city. Nobody is ranked, and a city we could not test is never listed as failing.
